boundaries.name: abi_encoding
boundaries.obligation: Compiler ABI encodeCall must serialize the exact typed method selector, addresses and amount without alteration.

boundaries.name: call_and_memory
boundaries.obligation: CALL return status/bytes and EVM memory behavior must correspond to CallResult; gas, reentrancy and rollback not extracted.

boundaries.name: abi_boolean_decoder
boundaries.obligation: Canonical Solidity bool decoding means 32-byte word0/1 only, with later bytes ignored; bytecode decoding equivalence unproved.

boundaries.name: caller_asset_checks
boundaries.obligation: Registry/code provenance, exact credited/received deltas, supported token behavior and caller reentrancy defenses require separate proofs.
